title: Rosemary strawberry balsamic shrub
steps: Mix the sliced strawberries and sugar in a bowl. Mash thoroughly. Cover and refrigerate for 36 to 48 hours so the strawberries macerate in their own juices.
Mix the balsamic vinegar and unpasteurized raw apple cider vinegar in a second bowl. Submerge one rosemary sprig. Cover and let it infuse for 36 to 48 hours.
Strain both bowls and mix them together.
Serve the shrub over ice with the limoncello sparkling water to taste, about 3 to 4 parts sparkling water to 1 part shrub. Garnish with the remaining rosemary sprig.
